card_title_en: Never-lose-the-base-position: covered option-selling around your fair value

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 我sell call sell put的原則是不弄丟底倉，至少在我認為的合理價以下不弄丟。
我是打算400元之前盡量不弄丟底倉，所以才會這麼做。

hkex_specificity: high — strikes and fair-value bands expressed in HKD on HK-listed Tencent/CNOOC; uses HK monthly options.
principle_summary: The core of his option program is selling calls and puts against a core stake (底倉) he refuses to surrender while the price is below his own estimate of fair value; he only lets shares go above his target (e.g. Tencent 400).
subprinciples: Roll puts/calls to collect premium without giving up the underlying below fair value
Willingness to part with shares is bounded by your own valuation (e.g. 400 for Tencent)
Keep a base position to avoid 'falling behind' (不掉隊) on names you want to own

verification.card_title: Never-lose-the-base-position: covered option-selling around your fair value
confirmed_quotes: post:222436722 ★AUTHOR comment:244799468 「我sell call sell put的原則是不弄丟底倉，至少在我認為的合理價以下不弄丟。」 — verbatim, author-attributed
post:222375639 ★AUTHOR comment:244813218 「我是打算400元之前盡量不弄丟底倉，所以才會這麼做。」 — verbatim, author-attributed (sub-thread mirrored under both cited posts with identical comment ids)
verification.corrected_summary: His option program is selling calls and puts against a core stake (底倉) he refuses to surrender below his own estimate of fair value, only letting shares go above his target (e.g. Tencent 400; CNOOC sell-call ~12, sell-put ~10). He rolls puts/calls to harvest premium while keeping the base position, on names he wants to stay invested in (不掉隊). Crucially, he frames this NOT as conventional covered-call writing — he describes his own sell-calls as '半裸' (half-naked), since he sells calls against shares he plans to acquire through put assignment rather than already-held stock. He attaches explicit risk caveats the card must preserve: he opposes ordinary investors touching these derivatives at all, and his hard rule is never sell a call without 100% of the underlying and never sell a put without the full cash to take delivery ('會死人㗎'), with no leverage as the bottom line. Best titled 'base-position-protected option selling around fair value' rather than 'covered'.
issues: Both citation seed quotes are verbatim and author-attributed: seed 1 is ★AUTHOR reply comment:244799468 (under post:222436722, answering @sarahalifa's question about a 330→380 put roll), seed 2 is ★AUTHOR reply comment:244813218. The core 底倉/合理價 thesis is genuine; the problem is over-claiming around it, not fabrication.

TITLE MISCHARACTERIZATION ('covered'): the author explicitly framed his own sell-call as half-naked, not covered — in post 222917670, replying to @frankieeid's 「手中有正股？還是裸call?」 he answered 「Sell call算是半裸吧？…我把要接的380那份也sell call了」, i.e. he sells calls against shares he only intends to acquire via put assignment. Calling the whole program 'covered option-selling' contradicts his own framing. (Within the cited threads, comment:244820759 「350元已經sell call，沒有貨賣了」 does show his call-writing is inventory-bounded, but that does not neutralize his own 半裸 label.) The refreshed crawl adds no comments altering this.

DROPS THE CENTRAL RISK CAVEAT: standalone ★AUTHOR post 223114673 — 「本人一向反對普通投資者觸碰任何的衍生工具，即便是sell call和sell put… 手中沒有100%的正股，千萬不要sell call；同理，沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要sell put。會死人㗇！」 The card presents a tidy strategy program and omits both his opposition to ordinary investors using these instruments and the hard 100%-underlying / full-cash preconditions. Nesting changes cannot affect a post body; still valid.
DROPS A SECOND GUARDRAIL: author reply in the 223114673 thread 「不用杠杆是底線，忌貪！別動任何歪念！」 (no leverage is the bottom line; do not be greedy) — a stated risk discipline absent from the card.

Subprinciple 'Roll puts/calls to collect premium without giving up the underlying below fair value' is well supported inside the cited threads: post:222436722 body (close 330 put → open 380 put, +12 premium), comment:244796940 (「我當初sell put收了16.5元，現在買回平倉方便開另一張sell put」), comment:244813218 (27 cumulative premium), post:222375639 body (Tencent 340→370 put roll; Alibaba 92.5→105 put roll). This part is faithful.

Subprinciple '不掉隊' is supportable but its phrasing comes from ★AUTHOR reply comment:245240418 「我只sell put，盡量保底倉不掉隊」 (re Alibaba) — the full-nesting context shows this reply actually sits inside cited post 222375639's own thread (correcting the original note that placed it in a different post), yet it is still not in either seed quote; add it as a third citation.

NOT weak_evidence: recurrence = 3 distinct author utterances (comment:244799468, comment:244813218, comment:245240418; the mirrored copies of the first two under both posts share comment ids and count once). HK specificity is supported (HKD strikes on 00700/00883/09988; special-dividend strike adjustment 12.5→11.31 with 1105-share multiplier in post:222375639 body; comment:245282847 「特別股息才調整，正常股息不調整」).

card_title_en: Sell puts only on companies you would happily own at the strike (cash-secured, bounded downside)

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 我只sell put我願意以那個價錢接貨的公司
我現在sell put，就算騰訊一夜之間價值為零，我虧損也就3%的事情。
前提是你對該股的價值有基本判斷

hkex_specificity: high — references being assigned HK shares and HK position sizing in HKD.
principle_summary: A sell-put is an acquisition tool, not a premium grab: he only writes puts at strikes where he genuinely wants to be assigned the stock, fully cash-backed, so the worst case is bounded (owning a stock he wanted even if it goes to zero costs only ~3% of book).
subprinciples: The strike is a price you have decided is a buy
Accept assignment as the base case, not as a failure
Worst case is bounded because positions are small and fully cash-secured
A value judgment on the underlying is the precondition for the trade

card_title_en: No leverage to take delivery: size sell-puts only to cash on hand, never oversell

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 用融資是找死
我sell put有多少錢就接多少的貨，絕不多賣。
大鵝已經很多了，我也沒有錢接貨了

hkex_specificity: medium — HK contract delivery context but the leverage discipline is general.
principle_summary: His hard bottom line is to sell puts only up to the cash he actually has to take delivery, never more, and never finance assignment with margin — using financing to take delivery is 'looking for death'.
subprinciples: No leverage is the 底線 (bottom line); guard against greed
Match put quantity to deliverable cash, never oversell
Capacity to take delivery is the binding constraint on size
Once a name is already a large holding with no spare cash, stop adding

card_title_en: Ordinary investors should not touch derivatives — and never short, never go naked

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 高危遊戲，手中沒有100%的正股，千萬不要sell call；同理，沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要sell put。會死人㗎！
本人一向反對普通投資者觸碰任何的衍生工具，即便是sell call和sell put。
如果多手做空0.5%倉位，已經爆倉，想想也蠻可怕的。對於一般人，不做空保平安！

hkex_specificity: medium — framed for HK retail option access; the no-short rule is general.
principle_summary: He opposes ordinary investors touching any derivatives, including sell-call/sell-put: never sell a call without 100% of the underlying, never sell a put without full cash to take delivery, and never short — misjudging the risk you bear can be fatal ('會死人').
subprinciples: No covered call without 100% of the underlying shares
No sell-put without full cash to take delivery
For retail, never short-sell: even a 0.5% short can blow up the account
The fatal risk falls on those who only think they understand it

verification.card_title: Ordinary investors should not touch derivatives — and never short, never go naked
confirmed_quotes: 高危遊戲，手中沒有100%的正股，千萬不要sell call；同理，沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要sell put。會死人㗎！

issues: Subprinciple-3 nuance, reworded from the original issue: in post 227101293 the author's '如果多手做空0.5%倉位，已經爆倉' uses the Cantonese idiom 多手 (acting rashly / itchy-handed), not 'shorting with many contracts' as the original issue glossed — there is no leverage claim in the sentence. The remark is anchored to the 尚乘数科/AMTD Digital (HKD) melt-up under discussion (the //@PaulWu reposted span; comments c251778257 and c251785089 describe the ~HK$2tn market-cap squeeze; c251788650 states the asymmetry '0.5%全赚了也是0.5%，亏可是无底洞'), where an unleveraged 0.5% short literally exceeds account equity after a >100x rise. The card's 'even a 0.5% short can blow up the account' is therefore accurate as a possibility claim, but the example is context-bound to an extreme squeeze; the author's own general rule is the explicit '對於一般人，不做空保平安！'. The original issue's 'leveraged short / multiple contracts' gloss should be dropped.

Framing note (not a faithfulness defect): the prohibition is voiced by an author who actively trades sell-put/sell-call throughout the same thread (post 223114673: c245747954 sell put 中海油; c246753329 and c247133425 sell call 騰訊; in c246763950 he even calls one of his own sell calls '半裸' because the underlying was shares pending assignment). The card correctly scopes the ban to 普通/ordinary investors and preserves his self-positioning ('本人非常清楚自己再玩什麼樣的遊戲…但我擔心，會有一些小朋友，以為知道自己在做什麼') via subprinciple 4, so attribution and scope are intact.

Attribution boundary verified for post 227101293: the post is a quote-repost, the author's words end before the //@PaulWu: span, and the seed quote correctly excludes the reposted third-party text (the leading 回复@PaulWu: prefix is boilerplate).

Recurrence and strength: beyond the two seed posts, the same discipline recurs in distinct author replies inside the 223114673 thread — c247433103 ('用融資是找死', never margin the delivery cash), c247180488 (sell put only up to cash on hand, '絕不多賣', accumulators are '無底深淵'), c251251720 ('不用杠桿是底線，忌貪！別動任何歪念！'). The inventory's recurrence=2 (distinct posts) understates the support; the full-context distinct-utterance count is 5. evidence_strength 'strong' stands — post 223114673 is a high-engagement standalone warning (👍149 💬370) explicitly written against imitators ('聲明一下…免得有小朋友模仿').

card_title_en: Avoid accumulators and complex multi-leg products with unbounded loss

citation_seeds.quote_zh: accumulator可是無底深淵，連自己最壞情況下會虧損多少也說不清賬。
我不會去考慮太複雜的工具，很容易出錯。

hkex_specificity: medium — accumulators are a notorious HK private-bank product; reasoning is general.
principle_summary: He refuses accumulators and complex structured products because their worst-case loss is a 'bottomless pit' you cannot even account for; he prefers simple instruments where the maximum loss is clearly statable, since complexity invites error.
subprinciples: Always be able to state your maximum loss
Complexity raises error probability
A sized sell-put caps loss even if the stock goes to zero; an accumulator does not

verification.card_title: Avoid accumulators and complex multi-leg products with unbounded loss
confirmed_quotes: accumulator可是無底深淵，連自己最壞情況下會虧損多少也說不清賬。
我不會去考慮太複雜的工具，很容易出錯。
verification.corrected_summary: In a single emphatic remark (comment c247180488 under post 223114673, answering a follower's concrete accumulator pitch in c247176620 — a 1-year daily-2x accumulator on Tencent/Alibaba at ~78%/68% strike discounts), he refuses accumulators and overly complex tools because, unlike a simple position, you cannot even state your worst-case loss: an accumulator is a 'bottomless pit' (無底深淵，連自己最壞情況下會虧損多少也說不清賬). He contrasts this with a sell-put strictly sized to cash he is ready to take delivery with ('有多少錢就接多少的貨，絕不多賣'): even if Tencent went to zero overnight his loss is bounded (~3% in his example), whereas an accumulator's is not. The underlying rule: only use instruments whose maximum loss you can clearly account for, and avoid complexity because it 'very easily leads to error' (我不會去考慮太複雜的工具，很容易出錯). Keep his load-bearing caveats from the same thread: he opposes ordinary investors touching ANY derivative including sell call/put (post 223114673 body: no sell call without 100% of the stock, no sell put without full delivery cash — '會死人㗎'), the loss cap holds only because the position is fully cash-backed, and margin is off the table ('用融資是找死', c247433103; '不用杠桿是底線，忌貪', c251251720). This is one forcefully stated utterance, not a recurring theme — the corpus repeats it only as duplicates (his own verbatim self-repost as post 224125866 and a commenter's copy c247202784), not as independent restatements.
issues: Recurrence/conviction/strength are inflated. The corpus contains exactly ONE distinct author utterance supporting the principle: comment c247180488 (post 223114673, 2022-06-30). All other occurrences are duplicates of it: standalone post 224125866 is the author's verbatim self-repost of c247180488 (with the questioner's //@TTBTT text quoted, which is third-party), and c247202784 is commenter @2017年6月底 re-pasting the author's text verbatim (the same user also copied another author comment at c245821538 — a quoting habit, not author speech). recurrence should be 1, conviction 'single emphatic remark' (not 'repeated'), evidence_strength moderate at best (not 'strong').
Both citation_seeds are two clauses of the same single utterance c247180488, so they provide no independent corroboration of each other.

Crosslink 'rm-neglected-tail-risk' is dangling: no such card file exists (re-verified on disk); rm-risk-type-taxonomy.md and deriv-anatomy-and-instrument-types.md do exist, and the nearest existing card is be-neglected-tail-risk.md under cards/cfa/10_behavioral_finance.

The card must keep the thread's load-bearing safety caveats: in the post body of 223114673 he states he is 'always opposed' to ordinary investors touching ANY derivative, even sell call/put, and requires 100% stock cover for sell call / full delivery cash for sell put ('會死人㗎'); the bounded-loss property of his sell-put example holds ONLY because it is fully cash-sized ('有多少錢就接多少的貨，絕不多賣'), reinforced by '用融資是找死' (c247433103) and '不用杠桿是底線，忌貪！別動任何歪念！' (c251251720). A reader must not infer sell-put is broadly safe.

Framing: c247180488 is a direct answer to a specific accumulator proposal (c247176620); the author himself generalized to '太複雜的工具，很容易出錯', so the principle's direction is genuine, but the card should anchor it as his refusal of a concrete pitch rather than free-standing doctrine.

The fully-nested rendering nonetheless sharpens (and confirms) the original analysis: (1) the parent question c247176620 is now cleanly bound — the author was refusing a concrete 1-year daily-2x accumulator proposal on 700/9988, and he himself broadened the answer to all '太複雜的工具'; (2) the apparent in-thread duplicate c247202784 resolves as a non-author copy by @2017年6月底 (who also copied the author at c245821538), and post 224125866 (verified in corpus_complete.md line 5112) resolves as the author's verbatim self-repost of c247180488 with the questioner's //@TTBTT text attached — so the distinct-utterance count of 1 is positively confirmed, not changed.

card_title_en: Selling premium harvests volatility/time-value, not direction (non-directional, probability-respecting)

和我之前sell call12元和sell put 10元一樣，不預判股價。

verification.card_title: Selling premium harvests volatility/time-value, not direction (non-directional, probability-respecting)
confirmed_quotes: post:223114673 (author comment c246370315) — sell put最希望股價不死不話
post:223866640 (★AUTHOR post body; identical to author comment c246815787 under post 223114673) — 和我之前sell call12元和sell put 10元一樣，不預判股價。
post:224024693 (★AUTHOR post body, author's own span before the //@郭荆璞 repost) — 我sell 了$中国海洋石油(00883)$ 七月份10元的put，收0.48；又sell了$中国海洋石油(00883)$ 七月份的call，收0.47元。你說不死不活，我是不是應該很開心
verification.corrected_summary: He sells cash-secured puts and covered calls to harvest option premium (volatility/time-value) rather than to bet on direction; the ideal outcome is a range-bound, flat underlying ('不死不活'), and his edge comes from respecting probabilities anchored to a fundamental floor (e.g. judging CNOOC's ~8.5 hard to break given mid-cycle oil earnings and dividends), not from a directional forecast. CRITICAL author caveats that must travel with this principle: he is on record opposing ordinary investors using any derivatives at all, and insists you must NOT sell a call unless you hold 100% of the underlying, and must NOT sell a put unless you have the full cash ready to take delivery ('會死人㗎' — you can get wiped out). He sells only what he is willing to be assigned on and never oversells, and treats leverage as an absolute red line ('用融資是找死'; '不用杠桿是底線，忌貪').
issues: All three seed quotes are verbatim and author-attributed, but the card drops the author's load-bearing risk/eligibility conditions. The very post cited for quote 1 (post:223114673 body) is an emphatic risk warning, not a strategy endorsement: '本人一向反對普通投資者觸碰任何的衍生工具…高危遊戲，手中沒有100%的正股，千萬不要sell call；同理，沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要sell put。會死人㗎！' — he is on record opposing ordinary investors touching any derivatives at all.

Omitted condition (sell call): his stated rule is covered-only — hold 100% of the underlying (post:223114673 body; reinforced by '擔心弄丟籌碼就別sell call' at comment:c245756450). Full-context nuance: he once ran what he himself called a '半裸' call against a pending put assignment (comment:c246763950), i.e. the covered rule is his public prescription while he tolerates a tightly-hedged personal exception; the card states the structure with neither the rule nor the nuance.

Omitted condition (sell put): cash-secured only — 'sell put有多少錢就接多少的貨，絕不多賣' (comment:c247180488, where he also rejects accumulators as '無底深淵'), '至少知道會有股息馬上到賬，這是原則' (comment:c247049368), '用融資是找死' (comment:c247433103), '不用杠桿是底線，忌貪！' (comment:c251251720). The card's clean 'edge comes from respecting probabilities' framing reads safer than the author's heavily-conditioned stance.

Mild over-formalization: in post:224024693 the author is reacting playfully to commenter 郭荆璞's 不死不活 phrasing ('你說不死不活，我是不是應該很開心'); he never labels the put+call pair a 'short strangle'. The structural reading is defensible (strikes were 10 put vs 10.5 call per comment:c246801782) but is an interpolation and should be hedged.

The non-prediction / probability / fundamental-floor subprinciples ARE well supported by post:223866640 ('不預判股價', '$8.5是很難跌破的', '概率上對我有利', '我尊重概率') and by '賺波動值的錢' (comment:c245752479). Those parts are faithful; the gap is solely the missing risk/eligibility caveats.

card_title_en: Keep sold-put strikes near the money; deep-OTM puts earn too little

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 偏離行權價太遠，吃不了波幅的錢
你這樣賺不到多少期權金的
不偏離行權價

hkex_specificity: medium — discussed on HK names but the strike-selection logic is general.
principle_summary: To capture meaningful volatility premium and keep a position, he keeps strikes close to the current price; a strike drifting too far out-of-the-money earns negligible premium and just ties up capital ('弄丟' = losing the position/premium).
subprinciples: Strikes far from price can't harvest the volatility premium
Deep-OTM puts collect almost nothing per unit of risk
'弄丟' means letting the strike drift too far so you stop earning premium
Premium must justify the strike

verification.card_title: Keep sold-put strikes near the money; deep-OTM puts earn too little
confirmed_quotes: 偏離行權價太遠，吃不了波幅的錢 — post 223114673, ★AUTHOR comment c246199966 (also duplicated under 223426897)
你這樣貺不到多少期權金的 — post 224796566, ★AUTHOR comment c248256350 (same id also under 223114673/223426897)
不偏離行權價 — post 223426897, ★AUTHOR comment c246199680 (also duplicated under 223114673)
verification.corrected_summary: For names he is willing to own and stay positioned in, and only below his willingness-to-own price floor (Tencent under $400, Alibaba under $120 — "120元以上，我可能就不願意繼續sell put了"), he keeps sold-put strikes close to the current price: a strike too far out of the money "吃不了波幅的錢" (can't eat the volatility money) and collects negligible premium ("你這樣賺不到多少期權金的"), while a severely out-of-the-money short put just ties up capital ("我平的近期已經嚴重價外了，留著占資金"). His term '弄丟' (losing the 籌碼/chips) means losing his effective position — and by his own direct gloss, letting the price drift too far from the strike ("偏離行權價太遠，吃不了波幅的錢") so the short put neither keeps him positioned nor earns the volatility premium; near-the-money strikes serve BOTH staying positioned and premium capture, not premium yield alone. Critical preserved caveat: he opposes ordinary investors touching derivatives at all and insists one must never sell puts without the full cash ready to take delivery ("沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要sell put。會死人㗎！"; "我sell put有多少錢就接多少的貨，絕不多賣"; "用融資是找死"). The near-the-money rule is therefore conditional on wanting and being able to take the underlying below his price floor, not a standalone premium-optimization tactic.
issues: Sourcing is clean: all three seed quotes are verbatim ★AUTHOR text in their claimed posts — 「偏離行權價太遠，吃不了波幅的錢」 = comment c246199966 under post 223114673; 「你這樣貺不到多少期權金的」 = comment c248256350 under post 224796566; 「不偏離行權價」 = comment c246199680 under post 223426897. None come from (↪in reply to ...) parentheticals or third-party //@ spans (the //@狗不叫: span in post 224796566's body is the author quoting himself). Note these comment ids are duplicated across the three sibling threads and must be deduplicated for recurrence.

DROPS THE PRICE-FLOOR CONDITION. The near-the-money rule is explicitly bounded by his willingness-to-own threshold: 「騰訊$400以下，我願意繼續 sell put，盡可能不弄丟；阿里巴巴120元以下，我盡可能不弄丟籌碼，維持一定倉位不偏離行權價太多，120元以上，我可能就不願意繼續 sell put 了」 (comment c246184156). Above the floor he stops selling puts entirely; the card states an unconditional strike-selection rule.

DROPS THE TAKE-DELIVERY/CASH PRECONDITION AND THE RISK WARNING LIVING IN THE CITED POST. Post 223114673's body IS a safety disclaimer (「本人一向反對普通投資者觸碰任何的衍生工具…沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要 sell put。會死人咨！」), reinforced by c247180488 (「我 sell put 有多少錢就接多少的貨，絕不多賣」), c247433103 (「用融資是找死」) and c248219219 (「我也沒有錢接貨了」). The card cites this post yet preserves none of the caveat — a dropped load-bearing risk warning, hence overgeneralized.

弄丟 HANDLING — the original pass's claim that the card's gloss is 'factually wrong' was itself an over-correction. Asked directly 「您说的「弄丢」具体指的是什么呢？」 (comment c246196802), the author answered 「偏離行權價太遠，吃不了波幅的錢」 (c246199966) — in the sell-put context his own definition supports the strike-drift/volatility-premium reading the card uses. But 弄丟籌碼 fundamentally denotes losing the effective position/chips (「維持一定倉位」 c246184156; sell-call usage 「擔心弄丟籌碼就別 sell call」 c245756450), so the card's premium-only subprinciple is INCOMPLETE rather than wrong: it drops the staying-positioned half. The card body must carry both halves; it must not (as the original corrected_summary did) deny the premium reading outright.

The premium-thinness core is genuinely supported and repeated (c246199966; c248256350; c246213534 「我平的近期已經嚴重價外了，留著占資金」), so weak_evidence does not apply; the failure mode is dropped load-bearing conditions → overgeneralized.
verification.new_context_notes: All newly-crawled ids sit under POST 223426897 (the 2022-07-08 底線 thread, c248212492–c248317277). They add no author content unique to this candidate: every author comment among them (c248219219, c248256350, c248218446, c248278562) already appeared under posts 223114673/224796566 with the same comment ids. They do confirm seed quote 2 (c248256350) sits directly in the rolled-put discussion under the rolling post, and c248219219 ("我也沒有錢接貨了") plus c248218446 reinforce the cash-to-take-delivery precondition and the dynamic, valuation-bounded nature of his strike band. No interpretation change; verdict unaffected. (The revision of the 弄丟 issue is not driven by new comments — the c246196802→c246199966 definitional exchange was already present — it is a re-judgment of the original issue, which over-claimed that the card's premium reading was 'factually wrong'.)

card_title_en: Per-name sell-put price bands that govern when to keep writing

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 騰訊$400以下，我願意繼續sell put，盡可能不弄丟；$阿里巴巴-SW(09988)$ 120元以下，我盡可能不弄丟籌碼，維持一定倉位不偏離行權價太多，120元以上，我可能就不願意繼續sell put了。
120元以下，我盡可能不弄丟籌碼，維持一定倉位不偏離行權價太多，120元以上，我可能就不願意繼續sell put了

hkex_specificity: high — HKD bands on HK-listed Tencent and Alibaba (09988).
principle_summary: He sets explicit, name-specific price thresholds: below a floor he keeps selling puts to defend the position; in a middle band he holds near the strike; above an upper bound he stops because he no longer wants more shares (e.g. Tencent <400; Alibaba <120 keep, >120 stop).
subprinciples: Bands are name-specific and tied to his own valuation
Below floor: keep selling puts to avoid losing chips
Above the upper bound: stop, you don't want assignment
These are personal bottom lines that a fast move can challenge

verification.card_title: Per-name sell-put price bands that govern when to keep writing
confirmed_quotes: post:223114673 (comment c246184156) — 騰訊$400以下，我願意繼續sell put，盡可能不弄丟；$阿里巴巴-SW(09988)$ 120元以下，我盡可能不弄丟籌碼，維持一定倉位不偏離行權價太多，120元以上，我可能就不願意繼續sell put了。
post:224796566 (post body, inside the //@狗不叫 self-repost span) — 120元以下，我盡可能不弄丟籌碼，維持一定倉位不偏離行權價太多，120元以上，我可能就不願意繼續sell put了
verification.corrected_summary: As a fully-cash-backed sell-put writer (his stated precondition: never use leverage, and only sell puts when you have the full cash ready to take delivery — 'sold puts can kill you' without it; he also openly discourages ordinary investors from touching options at all), he sets explicit, name-specific HKD price levels that govern whether he keeps writing puts. As of mid-2022: below a floor (Tencent <400, Alibaba <120 HKD) he keeps selling puts and tries to stay near the strike so the position keeps harvesting the volatility premium ('盡可能不弄丟' = avoid drifting off-strike, which he defines as 'too far from the strike to earn the band's premium'); above an upper bound (Alibaba >120) he stops because he no longer wants more shares. These are personal, valuation-anchored bottom lines tied to specific dates, and he notes a fast move can immediately challenge them.
issues: The card drops the author's load-bearing precondition stated in the SAME anchor post body (post 223114673): sell puts only with 100% of the delivery cash ready and never on leverage — '高危遊戲，手中沒有100%的正股，千萬不要sell call；同理，沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要sell put。會死人㗎！'. He repeats this inside the same thread: comment c247433103 ('用融資是找死'), c247180488 ('我sell put有多少錢就接多少的貨，絕不多賣…accumulator可是無底深淵'), c251251720 ('不用杠桿是底線，忌貪！'). Omitting it turns a fully-cash-backed, risk-warned practice into a bare price-band rule.

The same anchor post opens with an explicit do-not-imitate disclaimer ('本人一向反對普通投資者觸碰任何的衍生工具，即便是sell call和sell put', post 223114673 body); the card presents the bands as actionable guidance without surfacing this caveat.

Subprinciple 'Below floor: keep selling puts to avoid losing chips' over-reads '弄丟籌碼'. Asked directly what 弄丟 means (questions c246192234 and c246196802), the author answers '不偏離行權價' (comment c246199680) and '偏離行權價太遠，吃不了波幅的錢' (comment c246199966) — i.e. stay near the strike so the position keeps harvesting the volatility premium, not 'defend the position / avoid losing shares'.

Minor binding note: seed 2's quote appears in post 224796566's body only inside the '//@狗不叫:回复@vincechencn1:' self-repost span. It is author-attributed (the author quoting himself), but post 224796566 is itself the timeline-repost twin of his comment c248212324 under post 223114673 (their comment trees share identical ids, e.g. c248219219, c248218446), so it adds no independent occurrence beyond one deduplicated utterance.

The bands are dated tactical levels for June–July 2022 (Tencent <400 HKD, Alibaba <120 HKD), not durable rules: the author himself reports a fast move immediately challenging the Alibaba 120 line ('這麼快就挑戰我底線了', c248212324 / post 224796566) and says the line could be adjusted a little if he closes the profitable 105/112.5 strikes (c248218446: '還是可以調一點的'). A card must frame them as time-stamped personal levels.
verification.new_context_notes: No new comment ids were added for either cited post in the refreshed crawl, so nothing material changes. The full-nesting render does sharpen the original issues' anchoring: the 弄丟-definition replies the original verdict cited via post 223426897 line numbers are confirmed as author comments c246199680/c246199966 under post 223114673's c246184156 subthread, answering direct questions c246192234/c246196802; and post 224796566's comment tree is shown to be an id-identical mirror of the c248212324 subthread under 223114673 (e.g. c248219219, c248218446 appear under both), confirming repost duplication and the deduplicated recurrence of 3 rather than the 4 physical occurrences the partial pass counted by line. Thread-internal author comments c247180488, c247433103 and c251251720 further reinforce (not change) the full-cash/no-leverage precondition issue.

card_title_en: Rolling sold puts down to a lower strike for net credit

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 平倉360元的sell put，虧9元每股，新開340元七月份sell put，收回11元。就這張期權而言，相當於騰訊七月份升回$340，能夠淨賺$2。
如果騰訊一直不回升，我按照$340接貨，無論交易佣金和印花稅都要比按照$360接貨少支付一些。
如果騰訊反彈至$350，你會後悔的

hkex_specificity: high — HK stamp duty and percentage-based HK commissions on assignment in HKD.
principle_summary: He rolls a losing put down: close the higher strike at a loss and open a lower strike for more premium, netting a credit even if the stock only recovers to the lower strike — and lowering the eventual assignment price (and its percentage-based fees and stamp duty).
subprinciples: Close 360 put (-9), open 340 put (+11) = net +2 if stock recovers to 340
Lower strike means lower commission and stamp duty on assignment
Costs and slippage are included in the calculation
Regret risk: if the stock rebounds past the original strike you lose the higher-strike upside

verification.card_title: Rolling sold puts down to a lower strike for net credit
confirmed_quotes: 平倉360元的sell put，虧9元每股，新開340元七月份sell put，收回11元。就這張期權而言，相當於騰訊七月份升回$340，能夠淨賺$2。
如果騰訊一直不回升，我按照$340接貨，無論交易佣金和印花稅都要比按照$360接貨少支付一些。
如果騰訊反彈至$350，你會後悔的
verification.corrected_summary: Holding a cash-secured short put that has gone against him, the author rolls it DOWN to a lower strike for a net credit: he closes the higher-strike put at a loss and opens a lower-strike put collecting more premium, so the position still nets a credit even if the stock only recovers to the lower strike (e.g. close the 360 put at -9, open the 340 put at +11 = net +2, which he frames as 相當於 Tencent recovering merely to $340 — a breakeven improvement, not an unconditional gain). A lower assignment strike also means paying less percentage-based HK commission and stamp duty if he is eventually assigned. Challenged that the roll's round-trip option fees and slippage erase the edge, he asserts these costs are within his calculation and the roll is still worthwhile, though he shows no figures. Critical precondition he insists on: sell or roll puts only with the full cash ready to take delivery, never on margin, and only on names he is willing to own. Acknowledged downside: if the stock rebounds past the original strike he forgoes that higher-strike recovery — he warns an imitator who rolled 350 down to 340, '如果騰訊反彈至$350，你會後悔的'.
issues: All three citation-seed quotes are verbatim and correctly author-attributed in the refreshed corpus, in the posts the seeds claim: '平倉360元的sell put…淨賺$2' = ★AUTHOR comment:249013851 under post:223819429; '如果騰訊一直不回升…少支付一些' = ★AUTHOR comment:249026833 under post:223819429 (the leading 回复@价VS值 prefix is boilerplate, the quoted span is the author's); '如果騰訊反彈至$350，你會後悔的' = ★AUTHOR comment:249028864 under post:225297451 (same comment id also surfaces under 223819429). No //@ third-party or parenthetical parent-context contamination.

Binding cleanup: the ORIGINAL pass's confirmed_quotes bound all three quotes to POST 223114673 — an artifact of the partial-crawl thread layout. The refreshed corpus confirms the seeds' own post bindings (223819429 and 225297451). This is a binding correction, not misattribution: the words are the author's throughout.

Load-bearing omission (drives the overgeneralized verdict): the author's repeatedly-stated precondition that sell puts must be fully cash-secured and never on margin ('沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要sell put', post:223114673) is absent from the principle_summary. The refreshed thread reinforces the take-delivery framing rather than weakening it: comment:246817028 '我不介意接貨，接了就反手賣call' and comment:246796783 (he holds June 370/380 sell puts he expects assignment on). Without the precondition the card reads as a free-standing premium-harvesting trick instead of a cash-secured maneuver.

Cost subprinciple now fully contextualized by the new nesting: comment:249033774 ('這些成本都在我考慮之內，還是划算') is the author's reply to the newly-captured skeptic parent comment:249031650, who argued the roll's round-trip 手续费和滑点 erase the edge. The author asserts the costs are considered but cites no figures, so the card must not imply a rigorous, quantified netting calculation.

The '+$2 net' framing must keep the author's own hedge: he says 相當於 Tencent recovering merely to $340 (comment:249013851) — the credit is conditional on recovery to the lower strike, a breakeven improvement, not an unconditional $2 gain. The existing subprinciple captures this; retain it.
HK-specificity remains well supported: percentage-based 交易佣金和印花稅 at assignment (comment:249026833) and HK exercise cost '0.3%' in reply to a fee question (comment:247185809).

Recurrence inflation risk: post:225297451 is the author's repost of his own comment:249013851 and its entire comment section duplicates the same comment ids as the sub-thread under 223819429; it contributes no additional distinct utterance.
verification.new_context_notes: The newly-crawled ids materially confirm rather than change the card's reading: comment:249031650 is the previously-missing skeptic parent (round-trip fees/slippage objection) of the author's comment:249033774 'costs are within my consideration' reply, so the cost subprinciple's context is now positively verified exactly as the original issue characterized it. The bulk of the new ids (c249045356 and its ~30 descendants) are an off-topic China Merchants Bank / mortgage-loan tangent and joke replies, irrelevant to this card. The refresh also exposes that POST 225297451 is the author's self-repost of comment:249013851 with a fully duplicated comment section (identical comment ids to the 223819429 sub-thread), so it adds zero distinct recurrence; and it corrects the original pass's quote binding from POST 223114673 to the seeds' claimed posts 223819429/225297451.

card_title_en: Roll deep-OTM near-dated legs forward to free capital (delta-vs-theta)

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 我平的近期已經嚴重價外了，留著占資金
平倉了六月份$阿里巴巴-SW(09988)$ 100元的sell put，新開了七月份105元的sell put，收取期權金6.89元
如果我平掉105元或者112.5元的期權，還是可以調一點的，畢竟那里賺了點錢

hkex_specificity: medium — HK names but the roll mechanics are general.
principle_summary: When a near-dated leg has gone deeply out-of-the-money it has little remaining time-value and only ties up capital; he closes it and opens a farther-dated, closer-to-money leg — closing the leg where delta now outweighs theta.
subprinciples: A deep-OTM near leg just occupies capital
Roll forward to a strike that again earns premium
Don't adjust right before earnings due to elevated volatility
Rolling is easiest funded from an already-profitable line

verification.card_title: Roll deep-OTM near-dated legs forward to free capital (delta-vs-theta)
confirmed_quotes: post:223426897 ★AUTHOR — 我平的近期已經嚴重價外了，留著占資金
post:223426897 ★AUTHOR (post body) — 平倉了六月份$阿里巴巴-SW(09988)$ 100元的sell put，新開了七月份105元的sell put，收取期權金6.89元
post:224796566 ★AUTHOR — 如果我平掉105元或者112.5元的期權，還是可以調一點的，畢竟那里賺了點錢

The author's reply [comment 246213534] never adopts that vocabulary; he gives his own simpler reason — '我平的近期已經嚴重價外了，留著占資金' (the near leg is deeply OTM, keeping it just ties up capital). All cited quotes are genuinely his; the delta-vs-theta phrasing is a commenter's lens he at most tacitly tolerated, and the card body must attribute it to the commenter or drop it. card_title_en: The wheel: take assignment then reverse into covered calls

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 我不介意接貨，接了就反手賣call
Sell call算是半裸吧？
如果接不到貨，那麼我就平掉sell call好了，再開個sell put的了。

hkex_specificity: medium — HK Tencent assignment example; wheel logic is general.
principle_summary: He treats assignment as routine: once put-assigned the shares he wanted, he turns around and sells calls against them. A call sold against shares he is only about to receive via a pending assignment is 'half-naked' until delivery; if assignment fails he closes the call and opens a fresh put.
subprinciples: Assignment is not a loss if you wanted the shares at the strike
After assignment, sell calls on the delivered stock
'Half-naked' call = sold before the underlying is actually in hand
Escape plan: if shares never arrive, close the call and re-open a put

verification.card_title: The wheel: take assignment then reverse into covered calls
confirmed_quotes: 我不介意接貨，接了就反手賣call

verification.corrected_summary: When his sell-puts are about to be assigned the Tencent shares he wanted, the author does not regard assignment as a loss — he takes delivery and sells calls against the stock (我不介意接貨，接了就反手賣call). On one occasion he pre-sold a July call against shares he was near-certain to receive the next day from deep-ITM June puts ('如無意外，我明天要接六月份370和380元騰訊的Sell put'), conceding when challenged whether he held the stock or was naked that this was 'half-naked' ('Sell call算是半裸吧？'). His escape plan if delivery failed: close the sell-call and open a fresh sell-put (如果接不到貨，那麼我就平掉sell call好了，再開個sell put的了). IMPORTANT CAVEAT THE AUTHOR HIMSELF STRESSES — in the very thread where this happened: '高危遊戲，手中沒有100%的正股，千萬不要sell call；同理，沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要sell put。會死人㗎！' (high-risk game: never sell calls without 100% of the underlying; never sell puts without the full cash to take delivery — people die from this). The half-naked sell-call is therefore a hedged, one-off edge case justified only by near-certain pending delivery, NOT a general technique he endorses; it must be presented with his risk warning attached and as a single instance, while the broader take-assignment-then-sell-calls wheel is the recurring conviction.
issues: DROPPED GOVERNING CAVEAT (most serious, now STRENGTHENED by full nesting): post:223114673 (a deliberate 聲明, 149 likes) states the author's bright-line rule: '高危遊戲，手中沒有100%的正股，千萬不要sell call；同理，沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要sell put。會死人㗎！'. OVERSTATED CONVICTION: '半裸' exists in exactly ONE distinct author utterance, comment:c246763950, mirrored three times in the corpus (as a comment under post:223114673, as a comment under post:223819429, and as the body of repost post:223828800). The card's recurrence:4 / conviction:'repeated' / evidence_strength:'strong' overstate the half-naked-specific claim — it is a one-off. Only the general take-assignment-then-sell-calls wheel recurs (comment:c246817028, comment:c247917105, comment:c247125242).

TONE/HEDGING flattened: comment:c246763950 is a concessive answer to frankieeid's challenge (comment:c246754573 '請教下財主手中有正股？還是裸call?') — 'Sell call算是半裸吧？' with the uncertainty marker 吧？ marks a hedged admission, not endorsement. The card recasts it as a defined, named technique ('half-naked call = sold before the underlying is in hand').

MISSING the near-certainty condition: he pre-sold the call only because assignment was effectively a foregone conclusion — '如無意外，我明天要接六月份370和380元騰訊的Sell put' (comment:c246763950), deep-ITM June puts one day before settlement; when jhwytw objected he might lock in an immediate loss (comment:c246780150), the author answered by pointing to the pending puts (comment:c246796783 '我手中有六月份370、380的sell put'). card_title_en: Covered calls are pocket-money on volatility, not a core return engine

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 我只是sell call賺點波動的零用錢，沒想到把家用都蝕精光。
擔心弄丟籌碼就別sell call，擔心接貨就別sell put！你有看到我sell call保險和電信么？
sell call 了1/4$中国海洋石油(00883)$ ，七月份，10.5元，收0.47元期權金。

hkex_specificity: high — covered calls on HK CNOOC/insurers/telecom in HKD.
principle_summary: He writes covered calls only modestly, to earn small premium ('零用錢') on volatility against a core holding he wants to keep for its earnings; over-doing it caps upside and can wipe out the gains, and he caps call quantity rather than maximizing premium.
subprinciples: Sell calls only in small size against a core holding you're reluctant to part with
A covered call caps your upside — only acceptable if you don't mind
Match the leg to the outcome you can tolerate (don't sell calls on names you want to keep)
If you fear losing shares, don't sell calls; if you fear assignment, don't sell puts

The principle_summary clause 'over-doing it ... can wipe out the gains' over-reads seed 1. Subprinciple 2 ('A covered call caps your upside — only acceptable if you don't mind') is reasonable financial inference but is anchored to no direct author quote. The author's expressed sentiment is reluctance ('也有不捨' in comment c246815787; '怎麼會捨得輕易弄丟' in post 222987869), never an explicit upside-cap statement.

Citation seed 3 (post 223857399, the bare 'sell call 了1/4...10.5元...0.47元' trade log) supports 'small size' only via the 1/4 figure and is thin as a standalone anchor. The stronger anchor is the author's nested reply c246815787 in the same thread: '和我之前sell call12元和sell put 10元一樣，不預判股價... 概率上對我有利。至於sell call，我也沒有打算大量賣，也有不捨，但我尊重概率' — which directly states he does not intend to sell calls in size and adds the load-bearing no-price-prediction / probability framing the card omits.

card_title_en: Option exercise mechanics: who controls exercise, OTM vs ITM, early exercise

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 月底才到期，行不行使put的權利，以及決定什麼時候行駛，決定權在買家。我是賣家。
但是買call的人不會行權的，當時call的期權市場價格還在0.5-0.6元，他為何要行權？
價內當然會行權，月底的事情，誰知道呢？

hkex_specificity: medium — HK American-style equity options; the mechanics are general.
principle_summary: As the seller you don't control exercise — the American-style buyer does, but in practice usually waits to month-end unless price is far below strike. An OTM call holder won't exercise (selling captures more value); an ITM option will be exercised, so a covered-call writer must accept shares being called away when ITM at expiry.
subprinciples: The seller waits; the buyer decides whether and when to exercise
American options can be exercised any time but usually wait to expiry
OTM holders don't exercise while the option still carries positive value
ITM options will be exercised — accept the shares get called away

verification.card_title: Option exercise mechanics: who controls exercise, OTM vs ITM, early exercise
confirmed_quotes: 月底才到期，行不行使put的權利，以及決定什麼時候行駛，決定權在買家。我是賣家。
但是買call的人不會行權的，當時call的期權市場價格還在0.5-0.6元，他為何要行權？
價內當然會行權，月底的事情，誰知道呢？
verification.corrected_summary: As the option seller (writer) you do not control exercise — the American-style buyer decides whether and when to exercise. In practice the buyer usually waits until month-end/expiry, unless price moves far through the strike. A holder will NOT exercise while the option still carries extrinsic (time) value: even when the underlying briefly trades at or slightly above the strike, if the option's market price exceeds its intrinsic value the holder makes more by selling the option than by exercising (as the author observed when his written CNOOC calls, struck at 12/12.5 with the stock touching 12.54, were not exercised because the calls still traded at 0.5-0.6). If an option is in the money at the decision point (month-end), it will of course be exercised — though, as the author cautions, who knows where the price will be by then. For a covered-call writer this means accepting that the shares can be called away if the call is still ITM at expiry.
issues: All three seed quotes are verbatim and author-attributed: comment:c244850495? — correction: comment:c244850476 (post:222436722) for quote 1, comment:c245590620 and comment:c245955741 (post:222987869) for quotes 2 and 3; in each, the quoted text follows the boilerplate 回复@user: prefix in a ★AUTHOR(狗不叫) reply, so attribution is sound.

Quote 2 is mislabeled as an 'OTM call holder' scenario. In post:222987869 the author had sold 00883 calls struck at 12 and 12.5 (author's own post body) and the stock touched 12.54 pre-ex-dividend (commenter comment:c245590395, which the author answers without dispute), i.e. the calls were at/slightly IN the money. The author's actual argument (comment:c245590620) is that the buyer still won't exercise because the option's MARKET price was 0.5-0.6 — extrinsic value remained, so selling the option beats exercising. The card converts this specific extrinsic-value argument into a generic 'OTM holder' claim.

Subprinciple 'OTM holders don't exercise while the option still carries positive value' is a category confusion: an OTM option has zero intrinsic value, so 'still carries positive value' misdescribes the author's point. His real insight is that a holder won't exercise while the option's market price exceeds its intrinsic (exercise) value — which characterizes ATM/slightly-ITM options with remaining time value, exactly his 00883 situation.

Quote 3's hedge is dropped in the subprinciple. 「價內當然會行權，月底的事情，誰知道呢？」 (comment:c245955741) conditions exercise on the option STILL being ITM at month-end, and the full nesting shows the parent question (comment:c245955164) asked specifically about the LAST holder before expiry — so the author's 'of course exercises' is an at-expiry statement. The principle_summary preserves this via 'when ITM at expiry', but the subprinciple 'ITM options will be exercised' states it unconditionally.

The covered-call 'shares get called away' framing is the card's synthesis, not a direct quote — a sound inference, consistent with the post body 「又回到我股票帳戶了」 (post:222987869) and comment:c245588533 「只是賣出call的期權，但是買方沒有行駛呀！」, but it should be flagged as inferred.

A directly relevant corroborating author line is NOT cited but supports the 'American but usually waits' subprinciple: 「交易對手可以隨時行使，但是一般來說都會等到月底，除非大幅低于行駛價」 (comment:c244853574, post:222436722). Note it was said in a sell-put context, so 'far below strike' is the put-side early-exercise trigger; a card generalizing to calls should phrase it as 'far through the strike'.
verification.new_context_notes: The refreshed crawl added zero new comment ids for both cited posts (bundle states 'none' for post:222436722 and post:222987869). The fully-nested 醉翁山水 sub-thread (c245588285→c245588533→c245590395→c245590620→c245955164→c245955741) confirms the original interpretation and slightly sharpens issue 4: the parent question c245955164 shows 「價內當然會行權」 was answering specifically whether the last holder at expiry must exercise. The several 2022-06-20 comments under post:222987869 replying to a deleted author comment (「讨论已被 狗不叫 删除」) are unrelated to this candidate. Nothing material changes; verdict unchanged.

Special dividends and in-kind/stock distributions trigger adjustment
Confirm the exchange's policy before selling options across a large dividend (US risk)

card_title_en: Dividend-aware option timing: ex-date, assignment timing, and who collects the dividend

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 我是沒錢接六月份的了，但是中海油七月中股息到賬，所以我才選擇sell put七月到期的
除淨日股票在誰的手就是誰收息
不行。別人是28號收市后行權的，你應該是29號收到被行權的通知。

hkex_specificity: high — HK ex-dividend (除淨) conventions and HK assignment-notice timing.
principle_summary: Whoever holds the share on the ex-dividend (除淨) day collects the dividend; he times sold-put expiry so the dividend lands before possible assignment. Assignment after the ex-date misses the dividend (counterparty exercises after close on T, you're notified T+1). Always check ex-dates, using prior years' as a guide since dividends are announced shortly in advance.
subprinciples: Whoever holds on 除淨 day collects the dividend
Time expiry so assignment occurs before ex-date if you want the dividend
Assignment notice arrives T+1, which can fall after ex-date and forfeit the dividend
Use prior-year ex-dates as the planning input

verification.corrected_summary: Dividend timing for HK sold puts — but only as a refinement of a cash-secured strategy the author frames as high-risk. His stated precondition is firm: never sell puts unless you have the full cash to take delivery, never on margin ('用融資是找死'), and he explicitly warns ordinary investors against touching any derivatives ('沒有準備好全額接貨的錢，不要sell put。會死人㗎！'). Within that constraint he times sold-put expiry around the dividend calendar in two distinct ways. First, cash-flow timing: he chose July (not June) CNOOC puts because he had no cash for a June assignment but the mid-July dividend payment would land in his account in time to fund taking delivery ('我是沒錢接六月份的了，但是中海油七月中股息到賬，所以我才選擇sell put七月到期的'; '至少知道會有股息馬上到賬，這是原則'). Second, ex-date mechanics: whoever holds the share on the ex-dividend (除淨) day collects the dividend ('除淨日股票在誰的手就是誰收息'), and assignment is not instantaneous — a counterparty who exercises after the close on day T notifies you on T+1, so a put assigned right at the ex-date boundary misses the dividend ('別人是28號收市后行權的，你應該是29號收到被行權的通知' → 收不到股息). Always check ex-dates; since dividends are announced only shortly in advance, use prior years' ex-dates as the planning guide ('參考往年除淨日', '看除淨日'). This is a HK-specific tactic (除淨 conventions, T+1 assignment notice) layered on top of a fully cash-secured put position, not a standalone yield play.

principle_summary: Selling a call through the ex-date then buying back at the ex-adjusted price creates no free dividend profit, because in a stock-loan/short the borrower must pay the dividend to the lender — whoever holds on the ex-date economically collects it, offsetting the price drop.

Short seller pays the dividend back to the lender
No free dividend-capture from borrowing the stock

card_title_en: Premium is the buyer's insurance cost and your edge — but a fat premium prices real risk

6-7%/month is regime-specific (elevated IV), not a permanent yield

Result is regime-dependent (underlyings drifting mildly up)
On a strong trender, sell-puts diverge a lot from holding the shares

principle_summary: He matches the number of puts he sells to the shares that incoming dividend cash can buy, so dividend inflows fund any assignment — keeping the program self-financing and unleveraged. Sell puts on dividend-paying names so dividends are assured to arrive
Capital constraint gates opportunistic sell-puts
Long-dated puts tie up capital too long

verification.corrected_summary: On HK equity options, the author asserts the exercise/assignment cost is about 0.3% — a terse one-word reply pushing back on a commenter's "nearly 1%" estimate, with no methodology given. Exercise incurs stamp duty, but letting an option expire unexercised avoids it; the author cites this saved stamp duty as one cost advantage of selling options over transacting in the underlying (the broader "premium-selling is cheaper than trading stock" framing is the card's synthesis, not his stated thesis).
issues: Lot-size subprinciple is self-contradictory and overreaches. The card asserts 'One HK contract = 1000 shares; never assume 100' as a rule, but the corpus shows the multiplier is NOT fixed: the author's own post:222375639 body describes a CNOOC special dividend adjusting the strike to 11.31 and the multiplier to 1105 shares per contract (producing 碎股), and commenter 思远的基金 states a 500-share multiplier for a China Mobile put (comment:c244852746) which the author leaves uncorrected (his reply comment:c244853574 addresses early exercise instead). The author's actual repeated rule is 'verify the share count every time' (comment:c244839614 '每次一定看淸楚股數！') and 'many people wrongly assume one contract is 100 shares' (comment:c244850635 '很多人以為一張合約100股'). The seed '一張1000股哦，別弄錯' (comment:c247010174) is a context-bound warning to a follower who said he would copy the trade (parent comment:c247007401, a general 跟上 remark under the June-expiry post 223990393) — not a universal '=1000' statement. The principle should lead with 'always verify 股數 — it varies (500 / 1000 / 1105 seen)', not assert '=1000'.

The headline '~0.3% (not the ~1% some assume)' is built from a split source: the '~1%' is COMMENTER @保安王师傅's estimate (comment:c247184793 '毛估估几乎要1%'), and the author's ENTIRE reply is the single token '0.3%' (comment:c247185809) — no methodology, conditions, or fee breakdown. The card presents this one-word reply with more authority than the source warrants, and none of the three citation seeds contains either figure.

The closing clause 'part of why the premium-selling path can be cheaper than trading stock' is the card's synthesis. The author does repeatedly link option mechanics to saving stamp duty (comment:c245752479 '賺波動值的錢，而且連印花稅都省了'; comment:c245756661 '沒有行權就省下了'; comment:c249026833 on a lower-strike assignment costing less commission and stamp duty), which supports the mechanic, but he never states the broader cheaper-than-stock thesis in those terms — acceptable as framing only if labeled as inference.

citation_seeds do not cover the two most load-bearing factual claims: the 0.3% exercise-cost figure (author comment:c247185809, inside cited post 223114673's thread but not seeded) and the 1105-share special-dividend multiplier (post:222375639 body, the post is cited but the seed quote from it is only the check-股數 line). hkex_specificity: medium — HK high-dividend holdings; the accounting principle is general.
principle_summary: He judges a holding by total return including dividends already received plus option premiums, not by price alone: positions can be 'in profit' on a dividends-included basis even when the share price looks underwater. subprinciples: Count received cash dividends + premiums, not just price
High-dividend holdings can be net-profitable through drawdowns
Dividend is a value floor, not a price floor
Don't add the dividend back into price-return expectations

Keep the buy bar deliberately high and restrictive
No qualifying candidate means buy nothing
Not being interested, after a look, is a valid pass

card_title_en: Engagement without overtrading; resist post-dividend itchy hands and extreme-return chasing

hkex_specificity: low — general behavioral discipline.
principle_summary: Finding enjoyment and staying engaged matters, because pure passivity breeds inertia that eventually drifts you out of the market — but this is not an endorsement of overtrading. Recognize recurring discipline risks: after collecting dividends investors get 'itchy hands', and implausibly high short-term returns (e.g. +47.56% in a month) are a disqualifier to blacklist, not chase.
subprinciples: Total passivity risks attrition from the market
Engagement is not a license to overtrade
After dividends, the urge to trade returns — recognize it
Extreme short-term returns are a red flag, not an attraction

The corpus does NOT support 'engagement without overtrading' as his framing: no anti-overtrading caveat exists in his words, and the engagement remark in fact encourages an active arbitrage maneuver. Treat these as three loosely related, lightly evidenced observations on staying engaged, on crowd behavior after dividends, and on distrust of extreme short-term track records — not a single articulated discipline framework.

Quote 1 (c246882025) is purely pro-engagement: it replies to @萌萌的二蛋 (c246879577: '不动，动亏了心情不好'), who declined to trade around the 神华 dividend, and warns only that inertia drifts you out of the market. The full comment thread reads it as aimed at funds/accounts flaunting +47.56% monthly returns via leverage or concentration (c247417306 '要么加杠杆，要么重仓某一行业', c247418959 '用投资人的钱去赌', c247424116 on biotech private funds, c247421050), i.e. 拉黑 = block/mute those accounts — making the card's stock-selection framing ('a disqualifier to blacklist, not chase') an unsupported inference beyond the bare text.

evidence_strength 'moderate' is overstated: each pillar is a single offhand remark with no elaboration, and the connective thesis binding them is the card author's, not the author's. Quote 1's second appearance as standalone author post 223905791 is a repost of the same utterance as c246882025 and deduplicates to one — recurrence is effectively three unrelated one-liners.

card_title_en: Talk-your-book discipline and incentive checks on commentary

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 我現在最接近的也只是6月和7月105元的sell put，現在阿里上漲對我一點好處也沒有，我瞎吹它干什麼？

hkex_specificity: low — general behavioral/conflict discipline.
principle_summary: Don't hype a position you don't actually hold — only positions, not rhetoric, benefit from a price move, so verify whether a commentator is positioned before weighting their bullishness. He treats agency / other-people's-money incentive asymmetry (bonus on a win, no penalty on a loss) as a reason managers gamble recklessly, distinct from how to bet one's own capital.
subprinciples: Only positions benefit from a move; check the commentator's exposure
His only Alibaba exposure was OTM puts, so a rally didn't benefit him
Other-people's-money incentives are asymmetric and reckless
Own-capital discipline must differ from agent risk-taking

Report this as his framing: he never characterized the puts' moneyness (not "OTM"), and a short put does in fact benefit somewhat from a rally. Separately, in a stand-alone one-line aphorism he framed other-people's-money incentives as asymmetric and conducive to recklessness: gambling big with others' money — bonus if you win, no penalty if you lose — is something "nobody would refuse", whereas gambling big with your own money is "a joke" (用別人的錢到一把大小，贏了有獎金，輸了沒懲罰，沒有什麼人會拒絕；用自己的錢賭大小，開什麼玩笑！). He named no specific referent — the fund-manager reading was supplied by commenters, not the author. In comment:c246780603 (post 223631520) the author says only "6月和7月105元的sell put" — he never characterizes the puts as out-of-the-money, and nothing in either refreshed thread does so. (The original pass additionally cited corpus evidence that the 105 strike was near then-spot, i.e. roughly at-the-money, and that he elsewhere wanted assignment; that evidence lies outside these two threads, but nothing in the refreshed threads supports 'OTM'.)

His-framing vs objective fact: "現在阿里上漲對我一點好處也沒有" (comment:c246780603) is the author's rhetoric — a sold put in fact benefits modestly from a rally (premium retention/decay). The card may report the no-benefit claim only as his stated framing, not as fact.

Thin / inflated recurrence: recurrence=2 conflates two separately-made single statements — the talk-your-book remark (comment:c246780603) and the OPM aphorism (post:224024456) — each stated exactly once with no development by the author in its own thread. evidence_strength 'moderate' is generous against conviction 'stated-once'.

hkex_specificity: high — HK small-cap AGM dynamics and HK names (北控/联邦制药).
principle_summary: He attends AGMs and treats directors as his own employees rather than seeing himself as a passive small shareholder; sparse retail AGM attendance is an information and influence edge. Sustained shareholder pressure can move a company toward peer payout (~30%), especially when low capex frees cash, and he gathers concrete operational detail directly from the board.

Low retail AGM attendance is an information/influence edge

Sparse retail AGM attendance gives him an influence edge (he notes the board feels some pressure facing him and he is often the only attendee) and lets him gather concrete operational detail directly from management. At the 北控 (00392) 2022 AGM he voiced dissatisfaction with past dividend policy; the company responded that its policy had already changed and that it would slowly move toward peer payout and 'try its best' to raise the payout ratio to or near 30% this year, noting low planned capex (slow 雄安 spending) leaves cash available. This is a single AGM interaction with an aspirational company response, not a documented sustained campaign or a verified payout outcome; the company also framed the policy shift as already underway, so causality from his pressure alone is not established, and he himself noted the implied profit level would require sustained high oil prices.

principle_summary's 'Sustained shareholder pressure can move a company toward peer payout (~30%)' overstates a single AGM interaction: post:222942928 documents one event where the author voiced dissatisfaction and the company responded. No sustained/multi-year pressure campaign and no verified delivery of the 30% payout appear anywhere in the full thread.

The company's reply was hedged aspiration, not a commitment or outcome: '今年會盡力將派息比率提升至或接近30%' and '將會慢慢向同業看齊' (post:222942928). The card drops this hedging. The author's own nested reply comment:c245560015 adds further conditionality — the profit level implied by a HK$2.5 dividend at 30% payout is '持續高油價才有可能' (only possible with sustained high oil prices).

The company framed the policy shift as already underway — '今年年報披露的股息政策已經有所改變' (post:222942928) — so causality from the author's pressure alone is not established. Commenter context (comment:c245480267, not author speech) corroborates: the ~30% target had already been aired at the prior results call ('之前推到南港投产争取30%').

Crosslink 'cc-standard-iii-a-b-loyalty-prudence-and-fair-dealing' is a weak/forced thematic match: CFA Standard III(A)/(B) governs an investment professional's duties to clients, not retail shareholder AGM activism.

Recurrence within the cited thread is 4 distinct author utterances (post:222942928, comment:c245764793 as the two core ones; comment:c245485840 and comment:c245791564 supporting the sparse-attendance observation). principle_summary: He weighs management share purchases as an alignment signal, especially when credible — all three senior managers putting in their own cash, or a GM buying roughly a year's salary worth — and monitors the absence of major-shareholder selling as supportive. Magnitude relative to the insider's income, not the act alone, is what makes it meaningful; it is one data point, not a standalone thesis.
subprinciples: 'Real cash from their own pockets' makes the signal credible
Magnitude relative to income (e.g. ~a year's salary) matters
Absence of major-shareholder selling is supportive
One data point alongside dividend-policy commitment, not a full thesis

card_title_en: Read major-shareholder selling through the cheapest-execution lens

hkex_specificity: medium — Tencent/Naspers block-placement context; the read-through is general.
principle_summary: He interprets large-shareholder selling by the execution route: dribbling on-market sales matched to the company's daily buyback signal an optics/signaling motive, whereas a genuine intent to dump size would use a block placement (even at a discount). So slow on-market selling implies the seller isn't really trying to exit large.
subprinciples: Genuine large exit uses a block placement, not slow on-market sales
Selling matched to daily buyback signals optics, not real dumping
The seller may be responding to its own holders' discount complaints
Execution choice reveals intent

card_title_en: Small-cap minority liquidity trap; curate the shared book for liquidity

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 大股東的優勢在於它可以大折價私有化，小股東的優勢在於我們可以拍拍屁股就走人。真心勸喻這種傻事少做

流動性原因，不想持有太多小票。

hkex_specificity: high — HK small-cap privatization-at-discount dynamics (David Webb cited).
principle_summary: Avoid accumulating a large minority stake in an illiquid small-cap: the controlling shareholder can take it private at a steep discount, while the small holder's only edge is the ability to walk away — which you forfeit once the position is too big to exit (his own ~3% stake took three years to exit). He targets high-liquidity, positive-cash-flow 'junk' value names for a shareable book and deliberately keeps illiquid holdings private.
subprinciples: A controlling holder can privatize at a steep discount; the small holder's edge is exit-ability
A too-large illiquid stake forfeits that exit edge (3-year exit example)
Screen the shared book for liquidity + positive cash flow (dividend/buyback, some growth)
Trim small-caps for liquidity even when income is acceptable

card_title_en: Diversification over single-name concentration; sector position ceilings

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 上個月還有很多人勸我sell put阿里不如都押700，反正就是阿里巴巴十萬個不好，騰訊地位不可動搖
加了728，控制行業上限倉位。
現金+套利交易倉位+ A股

hkex_specificity: medium — HK telecom sector-cap example; the construction logic is general.
principle_summary: He prefers diversification across positions to concentrating into the single 'best' name — herding into a consensus favorite leaves you fully exposed when it breaks (vindicated when Tencent fell and Alibaba rose). He caps any single industry by an explicit position ceiling, adding to other names in the sector (e.g. adding 728) to keep the leader within its allotted weight. The 'cash' bucket can span cash, arbitrage positions, and A-shares.
subprinciples: Don't herd everything into the consensus 'best' name
Cap each industry by an explicit weight ceiling
Spread within a sector to control the leader's weight
Defensive reserve = cash + arbitrage positions + A-shares

card_title_en: Insurer analysis: avoid opaque asset sides; sum-of-parts; ownership taxonomy

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 我真的不知道他資產端到底投資了多少地產債和信托，還在不斷展期呢！
太保的財產險至少值600億元，它的壽險不可能不值兩千億元
銀保沒將來，壽險的希望只能靠長期保單

hkex_specificity: high — HK-listed Chinese insurers (太保/平安/人保/中人寿).
principle_summary: He avoids insurers with opaque, unquantifiable asset-side exposure (property debt and trusts under continual rollover) — not knowing the magnitude of the risk is itself a reason to skip (his reason for omitting Ping An). He values insurers by sum-of-parts (P&C and life arms separately, with floors), takes the sector view that bancassurance has no future while life depends on long-term policies, and distinguishes joint-stock from SOE insurers and holding-company discounts.
subprinciples: Skip insurers with unknowable property-debt/trust asset exposure
Value by sum-of-parts: P&C and life separately, with floors
银保 has no future; life value depends on 长期保单
Distinguish joint-stock vs SOE; a controlling-holdco structure draws a discount

Asked why the four insurers in his new portfolio exclude 平安, he answered that he genuinely does not know how much property debt and trust product its asset side holds, "still being rolled over" — treating the unquantifiable magnitude of that risk as itself the reason to skip. In a separate 太保 thread two days later (post 222523338) he distinguished joint-stock insurers (太保/平安, 股份制) from the SOE 中人寿 (国企) and explained 人保's low rating as the market's discount on its controlling-holding-company structure. Caveats: each point is a single reply (the most-quoted two recur only as verbatim duplicates/self-reposts, not independent restatements); the sum-of-parts floors are 太保-specific and were never articulated as a general insurer-valuation method.

如果中海油不要求產量增長，每年折舊的費用完全是足夠新的資本支出。

hkex_specificity: high — HK-listed CNOOC (00883/883) earnings model in HKD.

Each +$1/bbl ≈ +25-26bn HKD profit for CNOOC
Track realized oil/gas prices, not just headline profit
Depreciation funds maintenance capex for a no-growth producer

hkex_specificity: high — HK-listed SOEs (神华 01088, CNOOC, 东风 00489); China SOE payout dynamics.
principle_summary: When the state is the controlling shareholder, a cash-needy government can simply raise the payout ratio rather than impose a windfall tax, since the dominant shareholder captures most of the dividend — a counter to windfall-tax fears. For high-payout state coal/power names, the bull case is the listed co sustaining super-high payout while the parent absorbs heavy new-energy capex; minority holders prefer dividends over the company itself building new energy. Catalyst for a catalyst-light SOE H-share is a payout-raising corporate action (e.g. A-share relisting).

Check whether new-energy capex sits at the parent (payout-supportive) or listed co (dilutive)
Minority holders prefer cash dividends to on-balance-sheet growth capex
Payout-ratio lever (A-relisting) is the realistic value catalyst for a dull SOE

card_title_en: Margin and cost-structure analysis: cost-plus, spread vs margin, pass-through, procurement

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 作為成本加成定價方式的制造廠，如果原料成本下跌只會令毛利下降，疊加庫存降價，毛利率也會是降的。
毛利差還是擴大了，但是毛利率並沒有擴大。
胰島素藥集採雖然降價達50%，不過由於銷售支出也會同步下降，暫時看對毛利率和利潤都影響不大

hkex_specificity: medium — HK-listed manufacturers (鲁泰/互太/联邦制药); the analysis is general.
principle_summary: For a cost-plus manufacturer, falling raw-material costs compress gross profit (and trigger inventory write-downs), lowering gross margin rather than helping it. Distinguish gross-profit-spread widening from gross-margin widening when input costs rise. Watch 'revenue up, profit not up' (增收不增利) when cost inflation cannot be passed to customers (geography matters). For centralized procurement (集采), the margin hit can be muted if selling expenses fall in step — assess net margin, not headline price cuts.
subprinciples: Cost-plus: falling input costs compress gross profit + trigger write-downs
Spread can widen while margin percentage does not
增收不增利: revenue recovers but un-passed input costs squeeze earnings
集采 price cuts can be muted by falling selling expenses — assess net margin

card_title_en: Balance-sheet quality: distributable cash, repatriation tax, receivables, leverage

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 賬上的錢在子公司。按照國稅法，向海外母公司派息，要交10%稅，如果子公司轉100億元往香港公司，只有90億元到賬，增加10億元稅項支出，直接影響利潤。
恒大的應收已經撥備，公司現在的應收都是銀行票據，風險較低，公司會加大風險管理。
公司今年是上市以來首次派特別股息，現在公司的現金流很好，和以前不一樣。

hkex_specificity: high — PRC-to-HK repatriation tax limiting HK-listed firms' buybacks/dividends.
principle_summary: Reported cash overstates distributable cash: PRC subsidiaries paying up to an overseas/HK parent incur 10% withholding (100bn transferred yields 90bn, directly cutting profit), so cash-rich firms may not buy back/pay out the full balance. Heavy debt explains a small dividend — read low payout against the balance sheet. Check receivables/counterparty quality (bank-acceptance-bill receivables are low-risk; a fully provisioned bad debtor de-risks the line), and beware partners running high leverage. A first-ever special dividend with strong cash flow signals improved capital-return capacity.
subprinciples: Reported cash ≠ distributable cash (10% PRC intra-group repatriation tax)
Heavy debt constrains payout — read low dividends against leverage
Scrutinize receivable composition and provisioning; bank bills are low-risk
Worry about receivables when partners run high leverage; a first special dividend signals improved capacity

card_title_en: Conservative, downside-anchored earnings underwriting under policy uncertainty

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 去年上半年基數并不小，希望增長50%以上有點貪心了。如果今年上半年每股盈利能夠有$0.45人民幣，我已經非常滿意了。
魯泰的看點是產能利用率的提升，不過由於我對它是否能夠恢復過去的派息比率不具信心，所以沒有介入。
6Apa和胰島素集采都有不確定性，所以全年業績我也不好判斷，0.8元應該會有

hkex_specificity: medium — HK-listed pharma (联邦制药); the underwriting discipline is general.
principle_summary: He underwrites on a probability-weighted, downside-anchored basis: set a satisfactory base-case EPS rather than chasing optimistic targets, and treat 50%+ growth off a non-small prior-year base as greedy. He bases the buy decision on confidence in restored shareholder returns (payout ratio), not just the operational-recovery story, and refuses precise full-year calls when policy (集采) drives genuine uncertainty — giving a floor EPS instead of a point forecast.
subprinciples: Set a satisfactory base-case EPS; discount high prior-year bases
50%+ growth off a non-trivial base is greedy
Gate the buy on restored-payout confidence, not just operational recovery
Give a floor EPS, not a point forecast, when policy uncertainty applies

card_title_en: Deflation worse than inflation; real vs nominal returns

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 對股票投資者而言，通縮遠遠比通脹可怕，溫和的通脹可以解決很多麻煩事。
複利是我借給你100擔大米，一年後你還我120擔大米，而不是我借你足夠買100擔大米的錢，一年后你還給我的錢只夠買80擔大米。
我認為主要原因是工廠供應過剩+內需不振

hkex_specificity: low — general macro/return framing with a China-specific note.
principle_summary: For an equity investor, deflation is far more dangerous than inflation — mild inflation solves many problems. Compounding must be measured in real (purchasing-power) terms: a true return is getting back more goods than you lent, not nominal money that buys fewer goods. He set realistic long-horizon expectations (even 10x-in-10-years is hard; ~20x-in-20 is good), revised down with experience. China stayed low-inflation despite global inflation due to factory overcapacity plus weak domestic demand.
subprinciples: Deflation is far worse than (mild) inflation for equities
Compounding is real purchasing-power growth, not nominal money
Calibrate long-run return expectations realistically (~20x/20yr is good)
China's low inflation: supply glut + weak internal demand

card_title_en: Rate-tightening regime: non-yielding assets sold first

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 加息收緊市場資金之時，一般都是不產生收益的資產優先被拋棄……比特幣不例外
美国企業全球化程度高，海外收入占比大，我更關心ppi變化

hkex_specificity: low — general macro framing.
principle_summary: When central banks raise rates and tighten liquidity, assets that generate no yield are sold off first (Bitcoin a prime example) — but even income-producing assets suffer when rates spike (mortgage-rate-sensitive REITs), so the rule is about the relative ordering of which sells first, not immunity. For globalized US firms with large overseas revenue, watch PPI (producer prices) more than headline domestic inflation, since input costs drive margins.
subprinciples: Tightening sells non-yielding assets first (Bitcoin)
Even yielding assets fall when rates spike — it's about ordering
Watch PPI over headline CPI for globalized firms
Input-cost dynamics drive margins for high-overseas-revenue firms

card_title_en: Oil macro: supply inelasticity, OPEC restraint, and refined-oil price controls

citation_seeds.quote_zh: 如果想油價跌，那現在油價一定不能跌
一直拒絕擴產的opec，一直支持俄羅斯的opec+秘書長
当国际市场原油价格低于每桶 40 美元(含)时， 按原油价格每桶 40 美元、正常加工利润率计算成品油价格

hkex_specificity: medium — China refined-oil price-control policy; oil macro is general.
principle_summary: Oil supply is extremely inelastic, so the price won't fall unless it first stays elevated (high prices ration demand and induce the conditions for a fall); OPEC/OPEC+ supply restraint is a structural reason to expect supportive prices. China's refined-oil pricing mechanism caps refiners at high crude (>$80 cuts processing margin, >$130 fiscal caps), so very high crude hurts downstream refiners — ~$85 crude is most favorable for Sinopec-type names.
subprinciples: Supply is extremely inelastic — price won't fall unless it stays high first
OPEC/OPEC+ supply restraint supports prices
China refined-oil price band caps refiner upside at high crude
~$85 crude is most favorable for downstream refiners

verification.card_title: Oil macro: supply inelasticity, OPEC restraint, and refined-oil price controls
